_comment: Coverage floor enforced in CI by check_ratchet.py. Raise these numbers whenever a change adds coverage; never lower them without a stated reason. Measured locally on Yosys 0.70 at 92.3% lines / 64.4% branches; the floor sits ~2 points lower until the first CI run (merged v0.57 + v0.66) reports its own numbers. What is not covered, and why, is listed in UNREACHABLE.md.
